consumers.proposerEligibility: Player with current Character control and active Session context
consumers.evidenceProfile: actor, Action source/rules, targets, costs, roll/seed, modifiers, computed result, proposed Effects, warnings
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: consumer allowlist for costs, roll evidence, modifiers, computed result, Effects, and reasons; authority and identities immutable
consumers.visibilityPolicy: Player-safe proposal/result; GM review projection; observer excludes protected proposal data
consumers.fallback: manual deterministic GM review without AI or paid services

consumers.proposerEligibility: authorized GM controlling the NPC or enemy
consumers.reviewerAuthority: same authorized GM or separately authorized assistant-gm according to Campaign policy
consumers.evidenceProfile: same Action evidence as Player path with controller and NPC/enemy identity
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: same F006 field-addressed allowlist and final confirmation
consumers.visibilityPolicy: GM full evidence; Player/observer only resulting authorized projection
consumers.fallback: same governed review and confirmation shell

consumers.domainAuthority: future social interaction packet and Campaign policy
consumers.proposerEligibility: authorized Player or GM with represented-actor control
consumers.evidenceProfile: social Action, participants, stakes, rolls/modifiers, proposed relationship or narrative Effects, warnings
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: domain allowlist; hidden motives and private notes never client-selectable
consumers.visibilityPolicy: participant-safe and GM-only projections remain separate

consumers.reviewerAuthority: Campaign GM for Campaign-local content; owner-authorized reviewer for canonical scope
consumers.evidenceProfile: content identity, source/provenance, dependencies, license classification, validation findings, compatibility, proposed publication scope
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: metadata and bounded corrections only; authorship, provenance, license, canonical scope, and protected source identity cannot be silently changed
consumers.visibilityPolicy: submission and source-license-sensitive fields filtered before queues and exports
consumers.fallback: repository-backed manual review with deterministic validators

consumers.domainAuthority: initiating consumer domain; AI has none
consumers.proposerEligibility: authorized human initiator requests an AI-assisted proposal
consumers.reviewerAuthority: same human/domain authority required without AI
consumers.evidenceProfile: input projection digest, model/provider disclosure, generated proposal, source/provenance references, uncertainty, warnings, cost/fallback status
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: human may edit proposal fields allowed by the consumer; AI cannot alter authority, owner gates, provenance, or final receipt
consumers.approvalPolicy: consumer-defined human review; never AI approval
consumers.visibilityPolicy: AI receives and returns only narrowed authorized projections
consumers.offlinePolicy: no AI call; local human draft fallback

consumers.domainAuthority: owning domain plus recovery and owner-gate policy
consumers.proposerEligibility: authorized subject for the affected object and scope
consumers.reviewerAuthority: domain authority; owner for irreversible, broad, production, or public effects
consumers.evidenceProfile: affected objects, dependency graph, blast radius, backups/checkpoints, reversibility, retention, warnings, recovery plan
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: scope may only narrow unless a new proposal is created; backup, authority, owner gate, and affected identity fields immutable
consumers.visibilityPolicy: protected existence and operational details remain scope-filtered
consumers.ownerGate: irreversible, production, credential, public, or broad destructive scope
consumers.fallback: deny or defer until checkpoint and authority services are available

consumers.proposerEligibility: authorized content creator or review process
consumers.reviewerAuthority: John Brandon Turner or explicit owner-authorized gate
consumers.evidenceProfile: candidate identity, source/provenance, validation, coverage, regressions, compatibility, license, migration, rollback, publication scope
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: owner may approve a bounded final candidate; material change creates a new proposal and new validation evidence
consumers.visibilityPolicy: private candidates and source-sensitive evidence remain restricted

consumers.domainAuthority: SS-10 ownership/custody/controller and consumer Asset rules
consumers.proposerEligibility: current authorized owner, custodian, controller, or transfer initiator
consumers.reviewerAuthority: required recipient/owner/controller according to transfer policy
consumers.evidenceProfile: Asset identity/version, current ownership/custody/control/location, recipient, quantity, container/slot constraints, transfer consequences
consumers.modifiableFieldsPolicy: recipient may accept or deny; quantity or terms changes require explicit allowlist and revalidation or a new proposal
consumers.visibilityPolicy: inventory and ownership projections remain Campaign- and subject-safe

compatibilityImpact: Consumers retain domain authority and Events while adopting the common envelope, states, reviewer shell, receipts, idempotency, recovery, projection, history, and accessibility contracts.
migrationImpact: Existing F006 proposal and decision fields map directly; later consumers must version their adapter and migration rules before activation.
fallback: A consumer with no compatible adapter must fail closed or use its approved manual/non-proposal path; the shared component never guesses domain behavior.
